note: M31.1d master template (aidm.data.master_template, read by aidm.rules.master_boost). Applies to a region master facing party_min heroes or more; solo and duo keep the M29.6 small-party hit point scale (owner rule). hit_dice_share: 0 = SRD average hit points, 1 = hit dice maximum. legendary_points: a master's turn, that many single attacks a round at the end of other creatures' turns, refilled on a d6 of at least legendary_recharge. trait: a features.json trait. floor_hp_scale_max: the most a master's hit points rise to reach the region's strongest spoke fight. full_party_hp_share (M31.1g, owner 2026-10-24 'Tune HP to the cap'): region tier -> share of those hit points a full party's master spawns with, never below the M29.6 small-party scale for the same party (what round 4 met), then the spoke floor. Tuned with the scripted sim grid (docs/playtests/M29_tuning.md, M31.1d and M31.1g): the hit dice share and the master's turn stay at 0; tier 2 at 0.8 (0.7 and 0.9 tried), tier 3 at 0.5 (the guard keeps a CR 5 master at its SRD hit points against four level-5 heroes), tier 1 at 1.0 (docs/DECISIONS.md M31.1g).
